trials.claim: Lifetime access to CutMe Short on Plan 1
trials.claimQuote:
Lifetime access to CutMe Short
- You must redeem your code(s) within 60 days of purchase
- All future Tier 1 or Tiers 2-3 Plan updates.
trials.reasoning: The binding terms let the vendor deny access and terminate accounts at any time in its sole discretion without warning, which materially limits the promised lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: WE RESERVE THE RIGHT TO, IN OUR SOLE DISCRETION AND WITHOUT NOTICE OR LIABILITY, DENY ACCESS TO AND USE OF THE SERVICES
exhibits.argument: Vendor reserves the right to deny access for any reason, which voids lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: WE MAY TERMINATE YOUR USE OR PARTICIPATION IN THE SERVICES OR DELETE YOUR ACCOUNT AND ANY CONTENT OR INFORMATION THAT YOU POSTED AT ANY TIME, WITHOUT WARNING, IN OUR SOLE DISCRETION.
exhibits.argument: Vendor can terminate accounts at any time without warning, contradicting lifetime access.

trials.claimQuote:
Unlimited QR codes
- Unlimited open-in-app links
- Unlimited destination URL edits
- Upto 50 folders for link management
trials.reasoning: The exhibits show QR codes can be created and a redirect can be edited once, but neither shows unlimited QR codes, unlimited open-in-app links, or unlimited destination edits.

exhibits.quote: I'm not a super user in this space, but I really love the ability to create short links, and also generate QR codes that are branded aswell.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms QR code generation works as promised.

exhibits.quote: If we update a landing page slug, we don't have to edit links everywhere - we just change the redirect inside CutMeShort once and everything's fixed.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms destination URL edits work by changing the redirect inside CutMeShort.
